Bennett was quick to re-order and even negotiated a discount for us, since the error occurred at the factory. We appreciated the integrity of both manager and crew. Reasonable price overall for the work they did. I'm very satisfied with the outcome. The crew did a wonderful job of trim and sanding, leaving me with perfect surfaces for staining and painting. I've scheduled additional work with this company.

Bennett replaced some rotted window trim on the back of the house and cloaked all the wooden trim on the exterior of the windows in aluminum. They were professional; the work was fairly priced, done in a day, and done well. I am thinking of hiring Bennett again this summer to do some insulation work and to give me a quote on upgrading my windows.

Excellent work Nick, Garrett, Patrick, and Bob. Wonderful attention to detail and would highly recommend Bennett as a contractor. Thank you.

Bennett just finished some work at my house, and I can't say enough about the fantastic work that they did with construction of a new overhang over my front door, and in rebuilding part of my deck. Patrick has a great attention to detail, deftly navigated some unforeseen surprises that popped up along the way, and kept me updated on status and his recommendations. Several neighbors have already noticed and complimented his work. I'm very pleased with everything that Bennett did and will definitely reach out to them again the next time I need work done.

We have been using Bennett for over 20 years and they have always provided excellent work, quality, trust and professionalism. Our recent front door installation was handled in a first class manner by Josh and Perry. Project support from Bryan and George was exceptional. Highly recommended!!

First , let me say that this company is a pleasure to deal with. We have had front and rear doors replaced, kitchen cabinet's moved to accommodate a larger fridge and now a new stainless drop in sink. this time our installer was Tony ( now to be our go to plumber) who was absolutely a pleasure to meet and have at our home. He was not only very considerate of our needs but kept me informed during the installation, to the very end of the job. He represents what a true craftsman should be and the type of talent Bennett has on staff. My wife and I couldn't be more pleased with our new sink..........

This project was a difficult structural repair of rotted wood on an outdoor “long house”. I was not sure if I could find someone to fix the rotted structural posts. Steve came over and reviewed and recommended Tom. Tom is a master craftsmen and artist in wood. They did an incredible job which I did not believe could be done!!

We are so happy with the bathroom renovation. David was very professional and always respectful of our home. Demolition of our bathroom was completed quickly and without dust and debris. The craftsmanship is impeccable and beautiful. I am very grateful for the team effort that went into the design, selection and installation. We will never go elsewhere for contracting work!

Very satisfied with Bennett's installation of a skylight in the stairwell of our 1847 built townhouse. Nice guys too!

I used the services of Bennett Contracting for insulation and window installation.  I last used them in the fall of 2010. They put in new insulation and replaced the window.  They did a really good job.  They were professional.  It did take some time, but they did the job.  They are pretty popular in the area.

I used them for my window replacement including 21 windows, a front door and a back door. They did fantastic job. They had a competitive price. They had professional staff and cleaned up everything when they left. There was no mess left behind.

Discovered a mold problem in attic. Caused by improper vent. Bennett knew exactly what needed to be done. Installed proper vents and I decided to add an optional attic fan. At the same time installed fan and vent unit in master bath. I have used Bennett in the past so I had high expectations. As usual they did everything in a timely and professional manner.

Two separate jobs (replaced windows and siding) around 2005 and 2006 approximately. My last contact was in 2009 for an estimate for bathroom renovation but we decided postpone the renovation. Great experience from the estimate, through selection of materials, visiting the showroom to see samples of both windows and siding, speaking with office staff, they were all very professional.

I called Bennett Contracting to install aluminum siding on my sun room. I had wood shake singles and the wood peckers found a home in the walls. They inspected my sun room to find water damage in the walls. This required replacement of the wall studs and and a new roof.  They furnished me a new estimate, which I agreed to, and proceeded with the work. The siding looks beautiful and complements the brick exterior of the main house.

We were very happy with Bennett. Both times we used them they were professional and very responsive to questions and concerns. The workmen were very punctual - work always began when we were told it would and the workers very, very diligent. They took a real concern in keeping the house clean and tried hard to minimize the disruption of the work to our family. We found their estimate was similar to ones we received from other contractors. We especially appreciated the willingness of the Bennett people to work with us in keeping costs down. We would definitely choose Bennett again.

Very professional and competent.  Offered ideas and suggestions and referred to suppliers who treated us with care and professionalism.  The workers who performed the actual work were craftsmen who took the time and patience to get the job done right and results were high quality.  The lead time for some smaller projects dragged out beyond our expected timeframe, but overall, we are extremely pleased with the results and would highly (HIGHLY) recommend Bennett to anyone looking to do simple, smaller jobs to larger remodels or additions.  The worksite was left clean and tidy each day; we experienced minimal interruptions; and, once the service date was established, the work was performed as scheduled.  Very reliable, responsive and competent!

We have a "Bennett House" because they did our siding, they did our windows, they rebuilt our front porch, they insulated our house, and they did repairs after a storm. I can only speak highly of them. I like that they clean up after themselves and that their work has been very competent. The men that have come out have been polite and I don't mind having them around. They would be the first ones that I would call.  We find that their prices are competitive and that we get what we pay for.

I've had many projects done by Bennett Contracting and I have never been disappointed. The quality of work on our bathroom and our screen room is outstanding. I've also had my house sided, a new front entrance, windows, lighting, ceilings done. You can't go wrong when using Bennett for home improvement projects.

Bennett Contracting did an excellent job re-siding and insulating our kitchen! We have a beautiful old brownstone and Bennett worked with the architecture of the building to make it all work! Wonderful job!

Great! The main contact, Kevin Gutman, was very professional and available.  Whenever I called Kevin with a question, he called back promptly.  The supply companies he worked with were also very professional.  We had no idea how to design a kitchen but Bennett helped us with all the decisions from appliances to countertops to plumbing.  Their workers were punctual and kept everything clean.  They also worked hard to make sure that everything worked the way it was supposed to and, even after the job was finished, came back the same day I called to fix a minor problem with the sink.  Because the work was over Christmas, we didn't get to make our usual Christmas cookies, so Dean, one of their carpenters, brought us a big tin of cookies that he made!  The window job was exactly the same.  Very nice workers who were punctual and made sure that every window worked well.  Very positive experience!

Bennett Contracting gutted our kitchen which included taking down a wall between the kitchen and dining room, pulling up linoleum floor, carpet, and hardwood flooring and moving windows along the back of the house They scraped off 3 rooms worth of popcorn on the ceiling and smoothed out the entire ceiling, installing can lights. They installed cabinets according to our layout, sub-floor and new tile floor, replicated and continued crown molding throughout the new layout. They installed pendent and under cabinet lighting and all the finishing touches we agreed upon. It took a couple of weeks longer than planned due to a change in our plans about flooring but they arrived daily and worked all day, leaving the workplace neat at the end of the day. The carpenter talked to us about the work and offered suggestions but always left the decisions to us. We were very pleased with the outcome and love the new kitchen. Our calls to the project manager were always returned the same day and our questions answered.

After quotes from several contractors we decided to hire Bennett to replace several double hung windows in our home. Although they were not the cheapest, the price was fair and the appraiser, Kevin, eased my concerns about preventing any lead/lead dust contamination as the home is old and we have a young child.  The 2 men, Jim and Carl, came on time and completed the work ahead of schedule and did a great job.  They even put a vent in and charged me nothing extra. We are very happy with the work and would hire them again. After the work we had the house inspected for lead dust by the department of health and they verified there was no contamination.

Bennett completely gutted the bathroom. They installed new ceiling, walls, floor, tub/shower, vanity, sink, toilet, door, lighting fixture. Did all Plumbing, electrical and tiling. We have used Bennett Contracting previously to remodel the kitchen. The same installers were assigned to do our bathroom. It was a 3 week project and the work progressed as scheduled each day. Bennett Contractors has been a professional and reliable company to work with.

From the first visit, we wanted this group. We hoped other estimates would come in higher so we would not be faced with a tough decision. We were not since Bennett's estimate was far lower than a company we had used before. Measurements (windows and siding) were taken to help with accurate estimate and re-taken even more precisely once the contract was agreed. When the materials were ready (about three-four weeks) work began. The crew was outstanding, especially Chris the manager. All were friendly and knowledgeable but, beyond that, totally professional in everything they did, an so hard working. They seldom stopped for a moment (did they even eat lunch??) Each day everyone arrived on time (Jared was 30 minutes early every day!) Materials were kept under control throughout the working day, cleaned and stored every evening. All questions were answered completely and in a very understandable way. When some old siding was removed it was revealed that there was a substantially dangerous situation with our electric wiring (due to another repair after a storm). The situation was explained very carefully to me, but the wheels for a safe and timely correction of the problem were already in motion by that time. Even the glitches seemed to run like clockwork with these people! When I showed some frustration at the way earlier repair (NOT by Bennett) must have been done, Chris explained why the other carpenter might have done it that way. Who knows, but I was impressed with his professionalism when he could have just as easily complained about the other guy. "Professionalism" was the name of the game with this crew. The house looks great. The windows work so well. The iron railing (an after thought on our part, but easily managed by Bennett, and cheaper than another estimate with lesser quality materials) finishes the whole project. Our only regret, was that we had not called them earlier for other work. We will definitely use this company again!

Bennett contracting was very easy to work with.  Workers were on time every day, were courteous, cleaned up the work site daily, answered all questions from customer, were very professional and did quality of work.

Bennett Contracting is always professional – willing to investigate any problems encountered/uncovered and make necessary repairs.  They replaced rotted garage door trim and rotted front door trim and investigated other water damage. Workers were knowledgeable and helpful.  Clean up was great.

The crews were impeccably prompt, professional, concerned to complete the job to the highest standards. Friendly and ready to explain everything.

Bennett Contracting personnel were punctual, professional, friendly, and ensured our satisfaction from initial estimate through completion of work.  A quality company with quality people.  I would highly recommend them.

My bathroom was completely gutted and redone. Work included radiant floor, spa type shower, tiling, painting, new toilet and vanity, ceiling heater/fan, etc. I also had a laundry room added to a first floor room. I was AWAY when this work was done and left complete instructions. They were followed meticulously and my house was in excellent order when I returned. This company is top of the line professional. I was given a lot of helpful advice by their "advance" man, who was able to understand my goals and he helped me achieve them. We were totally satisfied. The company had put protection over all my floors and did a complete clean up job so that you would not know they were even here - except we got a beautiful new bathroom and laundry room when we got back from Florida!

We had 3 estimates from different contractors to rebuild our home after a fire. Bennett came in with the most detailed bid, worked with us to avoid using an independent insurance adjuster (big expense) and have surpassed our expectations on the quality of the work. We had the entire house gutted and rebuilt including a complete reconstruction of the second floor. From the beginning the estimate came in quickly and was quite detailed. They even through in extras for free-remove a wall, change a window opening. The finishing work is being done now and it is better than the original builder. I would NEVER use anyone else. The work crew has become like family to us. We love them.

We just got our new windows installed today from Bennett and we love them! The service was professional from sales & selection to installation and they never pushed us into something we didn't want (which I can't say about other companies we talked to). We could not be happier with the product and the service! We would highly recommend Bennett to anyone. Can't wait for our new door tomorrow!

Replaced 39 windows, 2 storm doors and added vinyl siding and insulation to a sun porch.  House was built in 1920 and still had most of its original windows with 1950's-era aluminum storm windows.  Some of the window frames were rotted and all were painted with lead-based paint.  Bennett talked us out of using far more expensive wood frame replacement windows in favor of high quality vinyl frame windows.  Cosmetically, they are identical in appearance.  Bennett's carpenters did expert repairs to the rotted window frames in a very efficient manner that added little to the overall cost of the project.  The crew was very efficient and responsive and cleaned up the work area at the end of each day.  They did an outstanding job and I wouldn't hesitate to use them again. Estimates and detailed measurements were made at the end of July 2011.  Work was started in early October 2011 but was interrupted by extensive rain.  Crew needed inside access to remove the old windows and remove the lead-based paint.  This turned out to be less inconvenient than I originally feared as we generally only had to move furniture about three feet from the walls for access.  We allowed the crew to store project materials in our garage during the project.  Crew was very responsive to our requests including labeling 39 sets of original wood shutters.  Repairs to rotten wood were handled expertly and efficiently.  The crew also removed and replaced old insulation under the sun porch which proved difficult due to the extremely confined space.  They showed up in a timely fashion and left the work area clean at the end of each work period.  The end result was very noticeable in terms of heat retention and noise reduction - we about 50 yards from NY Rt 7. The final bill had no surprises.

We replaced 26 ancient windows with modern vinyl and wooden windows. We are happy with the windows. Their employees are professional. The window installers were very skilled and were considerate of us. I have no reservations about highly recommending them. From the beginning the estimate came in quickly and was quite detailed. They even through in extras for free-remove a wall, change a window opening. The finishing work is being done now and it is better than the original builder. I would NEVER use anyone else. The work crew has become like family to us. We love them.

Very pleasant professional experience from beginning to end.  Couldn't be happier with the result. Bennett ripped out and removed a set of pressure treated stairs with landing that was unstable and leaning away from the side of my raised ranch. Also replaced the side door to the stairs with a beautiful window, replaced outside vinyl house siding re: conversion from door to window, interior trim, drywall, and baseboard molding. Replaced a strip of dented vinyl garage molding and an outside electrical outlet cover as well. Attention to detail removed concrete stair footers along with the rest of the job, and had all completed in about 3 1/2 consecutive days.  My concern was that it was going to be messy and noisy, but I found no mess, and the noise was minimal and very tolerable.

I used Bennett Contracting Inc in last March. They did repairs in my bathroom, where there was a lot of water damage.  They did an excellent job. They communicated very efficiently and their estimate was correct. I would use them in the future.

We are extremely happy with the work Bennett did. They did a great job and my house looks amazing. Now I wish I could remodel the inside of the house to look as great as the outside. When that time comes we are definitely calling Bennett.

The job went smoothly and on schedule.   I had rotted exterior window framing, sills, and drip caps replaced on several windows and new framing around two doors constructed.   The job was well done and the work site was left clean. Bennett Contracting was very professional.  For a relatively small job they communicated with me several times, the salesman, Steve Drodzyk, came out to the site twice to meet with me, and the carpenter who actually did the job met with me once before beginning.  All my questions were answered and the work was fully explained.  I was not given the line, "Don't worry.  Just trust me.  It'll be fine," which I have heard many times before when I have asked questions.  I also received a quick response from the carpenter, Joe, when I had a question about the work he had performed.  He seemed to take pride in his work which is also becoming rare these days. I liked that Bennett adhered to state regulations, complying with lead regulations which other contractors I interviewed had not even mentioned.

Last year Bennett Contracting added a master suite, a laundry/bathroom, mudroom, basement, siding, insulation, and windows to our home. Each of the crews were on time, helpful, courteous, and cleaned up at the end of the day. The project was finished within the estimated time frame. We were very satisfied and would recommend Bennett.

Bennett Contracting did a bathroom remodel for us.  It included electrical, plumbing, construction, and all of that.  We are very happy with them; they are very responsive. We had them do several smaller jobs for us like rebuilding outdoor doorways and quickly doing some lighting for us.  They do the work well and they take their time.  I’m sure they could do speedy but we were looking for someone who was more careful than fast.  I really appreciated the extent to which they consulted with us as the job moved along.  They were very careful to discuss the options with us as things became apparent.  The manager checked in daily and the person primarily doing the work was careful and friendly.  I liked that the people working at my house all had great things to say about Bennett as an employer.  They had all been working for the company for a long time and they liked working for them.  They worked well as a team and I was very happy with them.  I thought the price was very reasonable and they were always here when they said they were going to be.

Bennett replaced all 14 windows, 2 sliding glass doors and 2 picture windows. The wrapping they applied to the outside of the windows is beautiful, they did an excellent job. At the beginning of each day they came in and told me what work was being done for that day and at the end of the day they cleaned up and came in to say good bye and what time they would be back the next day. They all were very nice and professional. They were finished when they said they would be and came in to show us how to work the windows. I would highly recommend Bennett Contracting to anyone...They won't disappoint....

We had two porches torn down and rebuilt this summer. The company and its staff were terrific to work with and we have had many compliments on the work that was done. We also hired Bennett to do work on the garage and install new doors. They went above and beyond our expectations. We will definitely hire Bennett Contracting again for future projects. They are professional, honest, and do excellent work. Thank you!

They are an A+ company all the way from the first quotes to the completed job. Bennett worked with us to stay in our budget. They installed 10 replacement windows. The product they sold is excellent, and it’s manufactured locally in Fonda NY. The installers went above and beyond to help us move furniture and other things as needed to complete the job. Other companies charge extra for these types of things. They were highly professional in all aspects. I highly recommend this company.  Workmanship was great too.

Thank you for making our dream come true.  Our new bathroom is beautiful.  We can understand why Bennett Contracting has been a respected and trusted business in the Capital District since 1915.  We felt a real connection with Steve D. and Chuck.  We appreciated the daily contact with Steve and Chuck and always knew our home was in good hands.  Chuck really cares and it is reflected in the work he does.  Steve was very helpful in coordinating the whole project and always keeping us informed.  We look forward to working with Bennett Contracting Inc. on future improvements to our home.  Great job!

Bennett replaced siding, windows, two sliding glass doors, new entry door, and rebuilt front porch. Great experience. Crew was professional and courteous.  Showed up when scheduled and on time.  Work was done to my satisfaction.  Work area was cleaned up every day.

Professional Kitchen Remodelers in Albany, NY

Your kitchen is one of the most important spaces in your home—it should be both functional and inviting. A thoughtful renovation can transform your kitchen into a stylish, comfortable, and efficient space that meets your family’s needs and reflects your personal taste.

Is It Time to Update Your Kitchen?

Normal wear and tear, such as cracked tiles, persistent leaks, or mold, is often the first sign that your kitchen needs a remodel. Other key reasons to renovate your kitchen include:

Upgrading to meet your family’s needs
Boosting your home’s resale value
Upgrading to fit your personal style
Increasing energy and water savings
Improving functionality and eliminating inconvenience

Work with a trusted local contractor, Bennett Contracting, who understands Upstate New York homes and ensures every kitchen remodel is completed with care, precision, and attention to your unique needs.

Request a Quote
Benefits of a Kitchen Remodel in New York's Capital Region

Planning a kitchen remodel comes with many benefits:

Upgraded appliances: New, high-performing appliances make cooking safer, faster, and more efficient, helping you tackle daily kitchen tasks like a pro.
More workspace: Remodeled countertops provide a bigger, cleaner workspace, making meal prep and entertaining easier.
Increased storage: Updated cabinets and smart storage solutions keep your kitchen organized and clutter-free while maintaining a sleek look.
Boost home value and appearance: Kitchen renovations enhance your home’s style and value. Even minor updates, like new countertops or backsplashes, can make your entire home shine.
Long-term savings: Energy-efficient appliances, lighting, and fixtures help reduce utility costs, allowing you to save money over time.

Ultimately, a kitchen renovation should reflect your needs, lifestyle, and the condition of your space. Working with Bennett Contracting ensures your remodel is handled smoothly and enhances your home’s style, functionality, and value.

Request a Quote
Why Work with Bennett for Your Next Kitchen Remodel Project?

At Bennett Contracting, we don’t just remodel kitchens; we transform your space to combine style, comfort, and functionality, delivering every project with precision and care. Here’s why homeowners in New York’s Capital Region have trusted our local, family-owned business since 1915:

Quality brand-name products and guarantees
Professional, highly skilled carpenters and craftsmen
Best-in-class training and safety measures
Superior customer service and communication
Accurate and timely estimates

We set the bar high, delivering the quality service and workmanship our customers have come to rely on. Plus, we’re consistently recognized as the Times Union’s Best of the Capital Region, Daily Gazette’s Best of the Best, Nextdoor Neighborhood Fave, NAHB SAFE Award winner, and Remodeler of the Year by the Capital Region Builders & Remodelers Association. We also do bathroom remodels.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQS) About Kitchen Remodeling
Are outdated kitchens considered unsafe?
